unit.bookReference: Lesson 14 Dialogue I turns 1–5, weather/seasons vocabulary, Activities I and V, and weather-question support.
unit.label: Weather & four seasons
unit.title: Weather and the Four Seasons
unit.description: Describe weather, name all four seasons, ask whether it snows or rains, and explain seasonal preferences.

goal.text: 因為我怕冷，所以我比較喜歡春天。
goal.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ pà lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān chūntiān.
goal.meaning: Because I'm sensitive to the cold, I prefer spring.

steps.prompt: Which sentence says today is colder than yesterday?
steps.explanation: A 比 B + property compares A as more of that property than B.
The audio begins with 天氣.

steps.prompt: In 開始下雪了吧？, what is the speaker doing?
options: making a likely guess and seeking confirmation
steps.answer: making a likely guess and seeking confirmation
steps.explanation: This is the already-taught inferential/guessing use of 吧.

steps.audioText: 下雪的時候，我常去山上滑雪。
steps.explanation: The sentence says the speaker often goes skiing.

steps.prompt: Why does the speaker prefer spring?
options: because the speaker is sensitive to cold
because the speaker prefers cold winter weather
because the speaker goes skiing every spring
steps.answer: because the speaker is sensitive to cold
steps.explanation: 我怕冷 gives the reason for preferring spring.

steps.prompt: Which season does the model like least?
steps.explanation: 最不喜歡冬天 means “like winter the least.”

steps.prompt: Which season word do you hear?
steps.explanation: The audio includes 春天 in the four-season sequence.

lessons.title: Rain and Weather Questions
lessons.subtitle: Ask whether it snows and how often it rains.

steps.prompt: Which asks whether snow occurs in Taiwan, without asking about frequency?
steps.explanation: 會不會 asks whether the snow event occurs; 常不常 would ask about frequency.

steps.prompt: Which asks whether rain is frequent here?
steps.explanation: 常不常 asks about frequency; 下雨 identifies rain.

steps.prompt: What weather event do you hear?
steps.explanation: The audio says it often rains in summer.

lessons.title: My Seasons and Summer
lessons.subtitle: Use weather and seasons in personal transfer.

steps.prompt: Which sentence describes the climate where the speaker is from?
options: 我的國家夏天很熱，冬天很冷。
我最喜歡秋天，最不喜歡冬天。
steps.answer: 我的國家夏天很熱，冬天很冷。
steps.explanation: 我的國家… describes the speaker's home-country climate.

steps.prompt: Which answer gives both a season preference and a reason?
options: 因為我怕冷，所以我比較喜歡春天。
steps.answer: 因為我怕冷，所以我比較喜歡春天。
steps.explanation: The sentence states a preference and explains why.

steps.prompt: Which sentence says “I like autumn the most and winter the least”?
options: 我最喜歡秋天，最不喜歡冬天。
steps.answer: 我最喜歡秋天，最不喜歡冬天。
steps.explanation: 最喜歡… / 最不喜歡… gives the most- and least-liked seasons.

steps.prompt: Which statement describes Taiwan summer weather?
steps.explanation: This is a weather statement about summer.

steps.prompt: Which sentence reports both a summer food habit and a common activity?
options: 夏天我常吃水果，也常出去玩。
steps.answer: 夏天我常吃水果，也常出去玩。
steps.explanation: The sentence gives both a summer fruit/food habit and an activity.

steps.prompt: Which sentence reports Taiwan summer weather?
options: 夏天我常吃水果，也常出去玩。
steps.explanation: This sentence directly reports Taiwan summer weather. The preceding personal-transfer card still instructs the learner to write the full findings in Chinese.

lessons.title: Unit 42 Review
lessons.subtitle: Retrieve weather, seasons, handwriting, and weather questions.

steps.audioText: 下雪的時候，我常去山上滑雪。

steps.prompt: Which question pattern do you hear?
steps.explanation: The audio uses 常不常 to ask about frequency.
會不會 asks whether the event occurs.

steps.prompt: Which asks whether rain is frequent?

冷.note: 冷 lěng describes being cold: 天氣很冷 means “the weather is cold.”
冷.memory: The two ice strokes 冫 on the left are a cue for cold; 令 fills the right side.

parts.label: 冫
parts.name: ice component
parts.description: Ice component in 冷: strokes 1–2. The two ice strokes 冫 on the left are a cue for cold; 令 fills the right side.

parts.label: 令
parts.name: right component
parts.description: Right component in 冷: strokes 3–7. The two ice strokes 冫 on the left are a cue for cold; 令 fills the right side.

滑.note: 滑 means “slide; slippery.” In 滑雪 huáxuě, the whole word means “ski.”
滑.memory: Water 氵 on the left can remind you of a slippery surface; keep the taller 骨 on the right.

parts.label: 氵
parts.name: water component
parts.description: Water component in 滑: strokes 1–3. Water 氵 on the left can remind you of a slippery surface; keep the taller 骨 on the right.

parts.label: 骨
parts.name: right component
parts.description: Right component in 滑: strokes 4–12. Water 氵 on the left can remind you of a slippery surface; keep the taller 骨 on the right.

雪.note: 雪 xuě means “snow.” 下雪 means “to snow,” with 下 describing precipitation falling.
雪.memory: The rain component 雨 sits above a short three-stroke base. Picture snow falling from the sky.

parts.label: 雨
parts.name: rain component
parts.description: Rain component in 雪: strokes 1–8. The rain component 雨 sits above a short three-stroke base. Picture snow falling from the sky.

parts.label: 彐
parts.name: lower component
parts.description: Lower component in 雪: strokes 9–11. The rain component 雨 sits above a short three-stroke base. Picture snow falling from the sky.

春.note: 春 chūn means “spring.” Learn 春天 chūntiān as the season name.
春.memory: Three horizontal lines and two spreading strokes sit above 日. Keep the lower sun centered.

parts.label: 春上部
parts.name: upper strokes
parts.description: Upper strokes in 春: strokes 1–5. Three horizontal lines and two spreading strokes sit above 日. Keep the lower sun centered.

parts.label: 日
parts.name: sun component
parts.description: Sun component in 春: strokes 6–9. Three horizontal lines and two spreading strokes sit above 日. Keep the lower sun centered.

冬.note: 冬 dōng means “winter.” 冬天 dōngtiān names the season.
冬.memory: A three-stroke upper shape sits above two separate dots. Keep both dots below the crossing upper strokes.

parts.label: 夂
parts.name: upper component
parts.description: Upper component in 冬: strokes 1–3. A three-stroke upper shape sits above two separate dots. Keep both dots below the crossing upper strokes.

parts.label: 冬下部
parts.name: lower dots
parts.description: Lower dots in 冬: strokes 4–5. A three-stroke upper shape sits above two separate dots. Keep both dots below the crossing upper strokes.

夏.note: 夏 xià means “summer.” 夏天 xiàtiān names the season.
夏.memory: Remember three levels: a top line, a tall 自, then the crossing strokes of 夂 below.

parts.label: 一
parts.name: top line
parts.description: Top line in 夏: strokes 1–1. Remember three levels: a top line, a tall 自, then the crossing strokes of 夂 below.

parts.label: 自
parts.name: middle component
parts.description: Middle component in 夏: strokes 2–7. Remember three levels: a top line, a tall 自, then the crossing strokes of 夂 below.

parts.label: 夂
parts.name: lower component
parts.description: Lower component in 夏: strokes 8–10. Remember three levels: a top line, a tall 自, then the crossing strokes of 夂 below.

秋.note: 秋 qiū means “autumn; fall.” 秋天 qiūtiān names the season.
秋.memory: 禾, the grain plant, stands beside 火, fire. Think of the harvest season as a memory cue.

parts.label: 禾
parts.name: grain component
parts.description: Grain component in 秋: strokes 1–5. 禾, the grain plant, stands beside 火, fire. Think of the harvest season as a memory cue.

parts.label: 火
parts.name: fire component
parts.description: Fire component in 秋: strokes 6–9. 禾, the grain plant, stands beside 火, fire. Think of the harvest season as a memory cue.

雨.note: 雨 yǔ means “rain.” 下雨 xiàyǔ means “to rain.”
雨.memory: Picture drops under a shelter: a top line and outer frame surround a central stroke and four rain-like dots.

parts.label: 雨
parts.name: rain shape
parts.description: Picture drops under a shelter: a top line and outer frame surround a central stroke and four rain-like dots.

u42-weather-cold.note: 天氣 is weather; 冷 describes cold conditions.

u42-weather-source.text: 外面風那麼大，我覺得今天比昨天冷。
u42-weather-source.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng nàme dà, wǒ juéde jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng.
u42-weather-source.meaning: The wind outside is so strong; I think today is colder than yesterday.
u42-weather-source.note: This keeps the first clause while using only already-taught characters. 比 is prior review.

u42-snow-mountain.pinyin: Hěn gāo de shān huì xiàxuě.
u42-snow-mountain.meaning: It can snow on very high mountains.
u42-snow-mountain.note: This keeps the weather claim without requiring the untaught place-name characters 玉山 or 美國.

u42-snow-when.text: 下雪的時候，我常去山上滑雪。
u42-snow-when.pinyin: Xiàxuě de shíhou, wǒ cháng qù shānshàng huáxuě.
u42-snow-when.meaning: When it snows, I often go skiing in the mountains.

u42-snow-guess.meaning: It has probably started snowing, right?
u42-snow-guess.note: Review the inferential/guessing 吧 already taught earlier; no new particle rule.

u42-spring-source.text: 我怕冷。我比較喜歡春天。
u42-spring-source.pinyin: Wǒ pà lěng. Wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān chūntiān.
u42-spring-source.meaning: I'm sensitive to the cold. I prefer spring.

u42-spring-comfort.meaning: Spring is nice; the weather is comfortable.
u42-spring-comfort.note: All support in this sentence is already known.

u42-winter-source.note: Seasonal comment; 太…了 is review.

u42-season-most.text: 我最喜歡秋天，最不喜歡冬天。
u42-season-most.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān qiūtiān, zuì bù xǐhuān dōngtiān.
u42-season-most.meaning: I like autumn the most and winter the least.
u42-season-most.note: Uses prior 最 for the personal most/least preference task.

u42-q-snow.note: 會不會 is the A-not-A form of 會. Here it asks whether the weather event occurs. This explanation must appear before assessment.

u42-q-rain.note: 常不常 is the A-not-A form of 常. This explanation must appear before assessment.

u42-home-country-model.text: 我的國家夏天很熱，冬天很冷。
u42-home-country-model.pinyin: Wǒ de guójiā xiàtiān hěn rè, dōngtiān hěn lěng.
u42-home-country-model.meaning: In my country, summers are hot and winters are cold.
u42-home-country-model.note: Personal transfer: This sentence is only a model. Before continuing, describe the climate of your own home country/place in Chinese using the seasons you know. Then say which season you personally like most and least, and explain your own reason with 因為…所以…. Say the answer aloud or write it on paper; do not copy the model unless it is genuinely true for you.

u42-season-reason.text: 因為我怕冷，所以我比較喜歡春天。
u42-season-reason.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ pà lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān chūntiān.
u42-season-reason.meaning: Because I'm sensitive to the cold, I prefer spring.
u42-season-reason.note: Personal transfer reminder: The model shows how to give a reason with 因為…所以…. Your own transfer answer must name your most- and least-liked seasons and give your own reason; the fixed spring sentence is practice, not a substitute for your personal response.

u42-summer-model.note: Weather model for the final transfer task.

u42-summer-write.text: 夏天我常吃水果，也常出去玩。
u42-summer-write.pinyin: Xiàtiān wǒ cháng chī shuǐguǒ, yě cháng chūqù wán.
u42-summer-write.meaning: In summer I often eat fruit and also often go out.
u42-summer-write.note: Personal transfer: discuss summer weather, one distinctive feature, common fruit/food, and a common activity; then write your findings in Chinese on paper. This card is a model, not the only acceptable content.
